definitions.explanation: The line of ancestry or family heritage passed down through generations. Refers to inherited family connections, traits, or social standing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{血筋|ちすじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: Born into a family of good lineage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{血筋|ちすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: He has samurai blood running through his veins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{血筋|ちすじ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Musical talent may partly come from lineage, but effort is also important.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧ (blood) and ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ (line/thread). Emphasizes the inherited nature of family connections, whether in terms of social status, physical traits, or talents. Can carry traditional or aristocratic connotations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血筋|ちすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: of good lineage
- {血筋|ちすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to descend from, to carry the bloodline of
- {血筋|ちすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: to have (someone's) blood running through one's veins
- ⟦{由緒|ゆいしょ}→由緒：13567_yuisho⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{血筋|ちすじ}: distinguished lineage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{血統|けっとう}→血統：14027_kettou⟧: pedigree / bloodline — more formal; often used for animals (e.g., racehorses) or royal lines
- ⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧: family line / genealogy — focuses on the documented family tree
- ⟦{家柄|いえがら}→家柄：16695_iegara⟧: family status / social standing — emphasizes the family's social position
- ⟦{血縁|けつえん}→血縁：14035_ketsuen⟧: blood relation — the biological relationship itself
